en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a Lutheran church with wooden pews, ornate pulpit on the left, chandeliers hanging from the arched ceiling, and an altar with a large crucifixion painting and decorative columns. Hymn number boards are visible on both sides. Printed caption text in Swedish appears at the bottom along with a photo credit and publisher information.
